falsification_conditions.condition: SPX closes above 5,600 on any single day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern analog is broken; that bottom featured lower highs and no V-recovery above prior resistance. A close above 5,600 invalidates the structural weakness thesis and suggests a false breakdown rather than accumulation base.

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 14.00 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The blowoff score of 40 implies elevated volatility/uncertainty. Sustained VIX compression below 14 would indicate complacency returning and risk-on normalization, contradicting the bottoming regime where volatility typically remains sticky or spikes.

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% and holds there for 5+ consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom coincided with a flight-to-quality bid in bonds with yields collapsing. A sustained sub-3.80% yield now would signal recession/disinflation panic rather than the soft-landing/growth-scare dynamic this pattern suggests; it would mean macro conditions have diverged from the analog's rate environment.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
